items.q: What is AURION and how does it work?
items.a: AURION is a premium IPTV streaming service. After subscribing you receive credentials that work in any compatible app on your devices — no dish or cable required.

items.q: Which devices are supported?
items.a: Smart TVs, Android, iPhone, Fire TV, Windows, Mac, tablets and any modern web browser. If it has a screen, it likely works.

items.q: How fast is activation?
items.a: Most accounts are activated instantly — usually within 60 seconds of completing checkout.

items.q: Do you offer a free trial?
items.a: Yes. Every new subscriber can start with a free trial to test quality and stability before committing.

items.q: What internet speed do I need?
items.a: We recommend at least 15 Mbps for HD and 25 Mbps for smooth 4K streaming.

items.q: Can I cancel anytime?
items.a: Absolutely. There are no long-term contracts, and we offer a 7-day money-back guarantee on every plan.

items.q: How do I pay?
items.a: You can pay securely by card, by bank transfer, or through the payment link we send you on WhatsApp. As soon as the payment is confirmed your account is activated.

items.q: How do I receive my login details?
items.a: We send your username, password and playlist link on WhatsApp straight after activation, together with a short setup guide for your device.

items.q: Can I watch on more than one device at the same time?
items.a: Yes. The 1 Month plan covers 2 devices at once, 3 Months covers 3, 6 Months covers 4 and 12 Months covers 5. You can install the service on as many devices as you like — the limit applies only to simultaneous streams.

items.q: Which apps can I use?
items.a: AURION works with any standard IPTV player — IPTV Smarters, TiviMate, Smart STB, Perfect Player and similar apps. We'll recommend the best one for your device.

items.q: Is a TV guide (EPG) included?
items.a: Yes. A full EPG with programme names and schedules is included on every plan, so you can see what is on now and what is coming up.

items.q: Do you have catch-up and on-demand?
items.a: Yes. Many channels include catch-up so you can watch a programme after it aired, alongside a library of 40,000+ movies and 12,000+ series on demand.

items.q: Do you show live sport and big events?
items.a: Yes. We carry the major European leagues, cups and international competitions in HD, along with the main sports and event channels.

items.q: Which languages are the channels in?
items.a: The line-up covers Swedish, English, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish and the major European languages, plus Arabic, Turkish and many more — over 18,000 channels in total.

items.q: What if a channel freezes or stops working?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp and we will fix it. Most issues are solved within minutes — usually a server switch or a quick app setting. Our team is available 24/7.

items.q: Do I need a VPN?
items.a: Usually not — the service works on a normal connection. If your provider slows down streaming traffic a VPN can help, and our team will tell you if it is needed.

items.q: Can I use it while travelling abroad?
items.a: Yes. Your account works anywhere there is a stable internet connection, so you keep your channels while travelling.

items.q: Is there a contract or automatic renewal?
items.a: No. Every plan is paid once for a fixed period and nothing renews automatically. When it ends, you decide whether to extend.

items.q: How do I renew my subscription?
items.a: Send us a message on WhatsApp before your plan ends and we extend the same account — you keep your settings and favourites.

items.q: Can I upgrade my plan later?
items.a: Yes. You can move to a longer plan or add more simultaneous devices at any time — we simply adjust the difference.

items.q: Do you help me set everything up?
items.a: Yes, free of charge. We send a step-by-step guide and, if you prefer, we walk you through it on WhatsApp until everything is playing.

items.q: Is my viewing private?
items.a: Yes. Playback is encrypted and we never share your details with anyone. We only keep what is needed to run your subscription.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the AURION IPTV service. By subscribing you accept them, so please read them before you order.

sections.p: AURION provides access to an internet television service. After payment you receive personal credentials that work in standard IPTV player applications on your own devices. No satellite dish, cable connection or set-top box is supplied or required.

AURION is an independent streaming platform and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any broadcaster, channel or rights holder. All artwork shown on this website is placeholder material; no third-party channel or brand logos are used.
You must be at least 18 years old and legally able to enter into a contract to subscribe. The subscription is for personal, private and non-commercial use in your own household.

Once payment is confirmed we send your username, password and playlist link on WhatsApp, usually within a few minutes, together with a short setup guide. Your credentials are personal. You may not share, publish, resell or sublicense them. If we detect credentials being shared beyond your household we may suspend the account without refund.

Each plan includes a set number of simultaneous streams: 2 on the 1 Month plan, 3 on 3 Months, 4 on 6 Months and 5 on 12 Months. You may install the service on as many of your own devices as you wish — the limit applies only to how many streams run at the same time.

Prices are shown on the pricing page and include all charges unless stated otherwise. Payment is made once for a fixed period by card, bank transfer or the payment link we send on WhatsApp. There is no minimum contract and nothing renews automatically: when a period ends, the subscription simply stops until you choose to extend it.

A stable internet connection is required and is your own responsibility. We recommend at least 15 Mbps for HD and 25 Mbps for 4K. We cannot be held responsible for playback problems caused by your own connection, hardware or network provider.

We work to keep the service running continuously and our support team is available every day, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free access. Maintenance, server changes and circumstances outside our control may cause temporary interruptions. If something stops working, message us and we will fix it as quickly as we can.

You agree not to use the service unlawfully, not to record, rebroadcast, redistribute or publicly display the content, and not to attempt to circumvent any technical limitation of the service. Breaching this section may result in suspension without refund.
Every plan includes a 7-day money-back guarantee. The full conditions are set out in our Refund Policy, which forms part of these terms.
Our liability is limited to the amount you paid for the current subscription period. Nothing in these terms limits any rights you have under mandatory consumer law that cannot be waived.
We may update these terms from time to time. The version published on this page at the time you order is the one that applies to your subscription. The date of the latest revision is shown above.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data we collect when you use AURION IPTV, why we collect it, and what rights you have over it.

sections.p: The operator named above is the data controller for the personal data described in this policy. You can reach us on WhatsApp for any privacy question.

We collect only what we need to sell and run your subscription: the WhatsApp number and name you contact us with, the messages you send us, confirmation that a payment succeeded, the plan you chose, and basic technical information needed to issue and support your credentials. We do not ask for or store full card numbers — payments are handled by the payment provider or your bank.

sections.h: 3. Why we use it and on what basis
sections.p: We use your data to activate and maintain your subscription, to provide support, and to keep records of transactions. The legal basis is performance of the contract you enter into with us, and, for record keeping, compliance with our legal obligations.

We do not sell your personal data and we do not share it for advertising. Data is shared only with the providers we need in order to operate: the messaging platform you contact us through, and the payment provider or bank that processes your payment. Each processes your data under its own privacy policy.

This website sets no advertising or tracking cookies and runs no third-party analytics. The only thing stored in your browser is your chosen colour theme, kept in local storage on your own device so the site remembers it on your next visit. It contains no personal data, is never sent to us, and you can clear it at any time through your browser settings.
We keep your data for as long as your subscription is active and for as long afterwards as we are required to retain transaction records. When it is no longer needed, it is deleted.
Playback is encrypted in transit and access to subscriber records is limited to the people who need it to provide the service and support.

You have the right to request access to your personal data, to have it corrected or erased, to restrict or object to its processing, and to receive a copy in a portable format. Message us on WhatsApp to exercise any of these. If you are in the EU or EEA and believe we have handled your data incorrectly, you may lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority — in Sweden this is Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten (IMY).
If this policy changes, the revised version is published on this page with a new revision date.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: Every AURION plan is covered by a 7-day money-back guarantee. This page explains exactly how it works and how to claim it.

sections.p: If the service does not work for you, you may request a full refund within 7 days of activation. This applies to every plan, from 1 month to 12 months.

We would rather you never need this page. Every new customer can start with a free trial to check quality and stability on their own devices and connection before paying anything. Ask us for one on WhatsApp.

Message us on WhatsApp within the 7-day window and tell us what went wrong. We will normally try to fix the problem first — most issues are a server switch or a quick app setting and are solved in minutes. If you would still prefer a refund, we process it.

Refunds are returned by the same method you paid with. Once approved, we issue the refund promptly; how long it then takes to appear depends on your bank or payment provider, typically a few working days.

sections.h: 5. When the guarantee does not apply
sections.p: The guarantee does not cover requests made more than 7 days after activation, accounts suspended for breaching the Terms of Service (for example sharing or reselling credentials), or problems caused solely by your own internet connection or hardware where you decline the help we offer to resolve them.
Subscriptions never renew automatically, so there are no unexpected charges to refund. When a period ends you decide whether to extend it.
This guarantee is offered in addition to, and does not limit, any rights you have under mandatory consumer law in your country of residence.
